text:
I would like to say that the doctor’s medication is very good and effective. Recently, I have been ordering the medication to be delivered to my home because I have not been available to visit the clinic in person.

Previously, the delivery process went very smoothly. Since we are in the same province, I usually received the package within 1–2 days. However, this time the situation has changed, and I am not sure why. It may be possible that the address was entered incorrectly. I made the payment on February 13, 2026, but today is February 25, 2026, and I still have not received the package.

I have been calling to follow up with the staff almost every day. Today, the staff gave me the delivery person’s phone number and told me to track the package myself. In my personal opinion, this staff member spoke in an unfriendly manner and did not seem responsible. There was no service mind.

When I asked to speak with the doctor, the staff told me that this matter was not the doctor’s responsibility. That made me feel very sad. I am currently undergoing treatment and have been improving, but I have not received the medication that I already paid for. On top of that, I had to deal with unfriendly communication from the staff.

Today marks the 11th day that I have been waiting for my medication. I sincerely hope I will receive it as soon as possible.

If the doctor happens to see this review, I would like to say that I truly feel sorry that your clinic, which provides good medical treatment, is represented by staff members who lack care, responsibility, and professionalism.

The quality of an organization is not reflected only in the doctor’s expertise, but also in how the staff handle patients and take responsibility for issues that arise.I hope this issue will be taken seriously and properly addressed. The clinic is very good and deserves to have kind and professional staff members. ☹️

We went to the doctor because of an itchy rash on our body that had been present for almost 3 weeks and was spreading to our face. Before this, we had seen a doctor at a hospital twice and received both oral and topical medication, but it didn't improve (we didn't see a specialist). So we decided to see a dermatologist at this clinic, which was recommended by a friend. The doctor listened attentively to our medical history, problems, and symptoms. From what I observed, and for those before me, the doctor spent at least 5 minutes examining and diagnosing the condition. The doctor also gave excellent advice (though sometimes they might have gotten distracted by other things, which was fine with me, but perhaps not so much for those waiting outside). The treatment and medication were very affordable and effective. If you're looking for a dermatologist, I highly recommend this clinic.

text: I recently went to the clinic, and the doctor gave me excellent information. I initially thought I had one condition, but the doctor later diagnosed a different one. The doctor is very knowledgeable and specializes in dermatology. It was a pleasure listening to them talk. The medication and price were reasonable. I recommend calling to book an appointment or arriving about 20 minutes before the clinic opens because they have many patients.

I had terrible acne that wouldn't go away no matter what I applied. Then someone recommended a doctor. The doctor was excellent, giving me medication to take and topical creams for about 3-4 applications. The doctor also recommended a pelvic exam to check my ovaries for cysts or fluid buildup, because external treatments alone wouldn't be enough. It turned out the doctor was right; I also needed to see a gynecologist to get rid of the acne. Now my skin has improved a lot; the inflamed acne has completely subsided.

I called to make an appointment, but it was terrible. They took my reservation, but they ran the queue completely messed up.
